sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 10169446 (one placeholder site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $15 per site per night, 2 vehicles included; additional vehicle $5 per night. Paying by Scan and Pay adds a $1.50 recreation.gov service fee, one night at a time.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/trout-creek-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $15 per night (2 vehicles included per site)', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per night'; Reservations: 'Cost is $15.00 per site with a $1.50 service fee. The mobile app will only allow you to pay for 1 night at a time.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169446/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-07 to 2026-10-13: PeakStandard 15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First-come, first-served; pay on site with recreation.gov Scan and Pay (QR code at the fee station, latest app required). recreation.gov also caps stays at 32 nights a year. Arrive no earlier than 2 pm, depart by 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/trout-creek-campground ('The campground is first-come, first-served. Scan and Pay is available for all sites.'; 'Arrival is no earlier than 2:00pm. Departure is no later than 11:00am.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169446 (notice 'The maximum stay limit is 16 days per reservation.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights each year, scanAndPay 1), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2026: Seasons of Use 'Open May 7, 2026 - September 29, 2026'; Current Conditions (updated Oct 13) 'Closes 10/13/2026', matching recreation.gov's 2026 rate season (May 7 - Oct 13).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/trout-creek-campground (Current Conditions 'Closes 10/13/2026.'; Seasons of Use 'Open May 7, 2026 - September 29, 2026.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169446/rates, read 2026-10-22

values.note: 12 back-in-only sites that 'can accommodate RV's 27' to 35' in length depending on the site'. The Forest Service page calls it 'Suited for pick-up campers, tent camping, and small travel trailers' and says 'large RVs/trailers are not recommended'.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169446 (Facilities: 'There are 12 sites in total which are back in only and can accommodate RV's 27' to 35' in length depending on the site.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/trout-creek-campground, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three vault toilets, trash service, picnic table and fire ring at each site, food storage lockers. Camp host and garbage service when the campground is open (recreation.gov says no host 'at this time').

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/trout-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'Camp hosts, garbage services are available when campground is open.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169446 (notice '3 vault toilets ... Trash service is available, no water or host at this time'; amenity 'Food Storage Locker'), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF (Superior Ranger District) campground beside Trout Creek, about 7 mi east of Superior: I-90 exit 47, then Diamond Road about 5 mi (paved) and Trout Creek Road #250 for 2 mi (improved gravel). Forested, cool and shady, with graveled roads and spacious, well-screened sites, several creekside. Gas and groceries within 7 miles. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Oct 13, 2026) + recreation.gov: confirmed $15 (rate table and FS), FCFS via Scan and Pay, 12 sites, vault toilets, no potable water. Added the $5 extra-vehicle fee, 16-night limit, season (2026: May 7 - Oct 13; Seasons of Use said Sept 29), max 35 ft (27-35 by site), back-in only. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Criteria check (rig suitability): the Forest Service page says the campground is 'Suited for pick-up campers, tent camping, and small travel trailers' and 'No camping is allowed in the parking lot and large RVs/trailers are not recommended', while recreation.gov says the 12 back-in sites 'can accommodate RV's 27' to 35' in length depending on the site'. An explicit agency 'large RVs/trailers are not recommended' statement; a 23-ft motorhome is within the rec.gov range, so a human should decide.
